settings.name: challengeCacheMaxEntries
settings.description: How many unredeemed challenges the endpoint keeps in memory, -1 for no limit; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's; with Redis it is not used; without Redis (OIDF_REDIS_URL, in platform-redis) the challenges are in this node's memory, which the production profile allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted (OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS) and otherwise refuses the endpoint's component - ATTESTATION_AUTH for the authorization server's, ATTESTATION_ISSUER for the attester's

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from -1 to 2147483647, or 0 in memory: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable; its challenges keep the settings they had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning

settings.name: challengeTtlSeconds
settings.description: How long a challenge the endpoint issues can be redeemed, in seconds, in memory and in Redis alike; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 1: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable; its challenges keep the settings they had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning

settings.name: challengeRateLimitPerWindow
settings.description: How many challenges one caller (by remote address) may have from the endpoint in a window; over it, 429 slow_down with Retry-After; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default

settings.name: challengeRateLimitWindowSeconds
settings.description: The endpoint's rate-limit window, in seconds; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default

settings.name: challengeRateLimitMaxCallers
settings.description: How many callers the endpoint's rate limit counts at once, the oldest forgotten first; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default

settings.name: replayCacheMaxEntries
settings.description: How many PoP and DPoP jtis the authorization server's in-memory replay cache keeps, -1 for no limit; read on ClientAttestationChallengeServlet only, at deploy, and not used with Redis; without Redis (OIDF_REDIS_URL, in platform-redis) the replay cache is in this node's memory, which the production profile allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted (OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS) and otherwise refuses ATTESTATION_AUTH

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from -1 to 2147483647, or 0 in memory: the authorization server's challenge endpoint is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the replay cache keeps the size it had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning
